title: Adopt native Spine rendering and character action scheduling
objective: Adopt the supplied Closure Spine model and validated action scheduler in the desktop assistant, preserving the current window, chat, speech, reminders, private settings and local runtime customizations. Complete exact-head CI, reviewed merge, merged delivery and reversible scoped activation under the user's explicit solution selection. Do not infer a Spine licence or incur fees.
architecture: On 2026-11-23 the user explicitly authorized Codex direct implementation and temporarily suspended Claude-guided execution. TASK-0009 / PR #8 delivered that executor mode. The user then inspected the local preview and selected this solution: “没啥问题，先用套方案吧”. Proceed with the already authorized CI/merge and adopt the feature in the existing daily runtime. This records solution selection, not licence ownership or acceptance of a future unverified build. Preserve unrelated legacy/live source and private settings.

The user supplied isHarryh/Ark-Models commit b799ffe8ee30bbb1b04f3c551234edfab8d5549a, directory models/4228_closur. The host seeds the three hash-verified files under src/main/resources/animations/closure/spine/. The binary is Spine 3.8.99, 297 bones, 117 slots, 74 mesh plus 53 region attachments, one 624x624 premultiplied-alpha texture with 122 atlas regions. Animations: Default 0 seconds; Interact 3.366667; Move, Relax, Sit each 8; Sleep 5.333333. There is no editable .spine project and no authored Talk/Thinking/Happy animation.

Pin com.esotericsoftware.spine:spine-libgdx:3.8.99.1 and compatible libGDX core (1.10.0 was already used for successful host-only parsing). No GPU/OpenGL backend, browser, native game engine, subprocess or external service is required. Adapt the existing Swing PetAnimationPanel to host an interchangeable renderer. Reuse AnimationPlayer and AnimationController, with compatible constructors and a frame-renderer fallback; a closure.animation=frames switch must remain available. The desktop assistant should visibly use Spine by default, while retaining the standalone offline evaluation entry point.

Implement a CPU renderer using the runtime's bone/constraint/deform calculations and Java BufferedImage output. It must correctly support weighted meshes, draw order, attachment colours, rotated/trimmed atlas regions and the actual PMA input. Do not flatten the source into prerecorded frames or require a GL Texture for metadata-only parsing. A custom AttachmentLoader can retain atlas metadata; region local offsets must respect crop/original dimensions and mesh UVs must account for atlas rotation/trim. Rendering must preserve transparency with correct alpha composition, avoid triangle seam artefacts and expose unsupported attachment/blend features honestly. This actual model has no clipping attachments. Determine stable camera bounds from sampled poses or another justified fixed envelope, so changing actions does not resize/recentre every frame or clip the head/feet/props. Support the actual one additive-blend slot as well as the 116 normal slots.

Keep UI and synthesis threads responsive: bound rendering to around 30 FPS, keep expensive rendering off the Swing EDT, publish completed images safely, serialize runtime mutation, and stop timers/executors on dispose. One-shot completion must be delivered reliably without stale callbacks overriding a newer action. Missing/corrupt Spine resources must produce a useful diagnostic and fall back to the existing frames rather than crash startup.

Introduce CharacterState and deterministic scheduling separate from rendering. Persist currently requested talking/thinking/idle/sleep base state while a higher-priority tap/greeting/happy action plays. An interaction must complete and restore the current base state, including when speech starts or finishes during the interaction; stop/dispose must invalidate stale completion events. Use Relax as the idle candidate, Interact for short interaction/greeting/happy, Sleep for sleep, and Sit or a documented bounded procedural variant for thinking after visual review. Expose Move/Sit/Sleep and all source actions in an offline preview so none are guessed from names alone. Keep legacy frame behaviour compatible when explicitly selected.

Give TALKING a visible, restrained procedural mouth/head activity layered over an appropriate source pose, gated by the existing real speech start/finish callbacks. THINKING and positive emotion may use authored base actions plus bounded procedural changes; describe these truthfully as program-driven variants, not new authored or phoneme-synchronized animation. Reuse the existing AssistantReply dominantEmotion; do not change the LLM JSON schema or prompts. Connect thinking start/complete/error and positive emotion through a small optional UI/activity listener rather than modifying ChatService or TTS generation. Multiple overlapping requests must not leave the character permanently thinking or interrupt active speech. Existing ChatWindow/ChatView constructors must continue to work.

Provide an offline headless preview/export entry point or focused test fixture that renders all six source actions and the added talk/thinking states into PNG contact sheets and/or GIFs outside tracked source. Include transparent and dark/light-background QA views. Tests must exercise actual model loading/rendering plus scheduling races, fallback and cleanup. The host will inspect the real previews and run native window startup.

Runtime licence ownership remains unconfirmed; the user previously answered uncertain. Preserve the original runtime copyright/licence and exact asset provenance/noncommercial notice. Document that the official runtime licence requires a Spine Editor licence for users outside integration/evaluation unless the integrator holds an applicable licence. The latest request authorizes engineering adoption; it is not evidence of licence ownership, a purchase or commercial permission. Do not impose another approval gate on the authorized development workflow or mislabel everyday use as exempt evaluation.

Use the separately merged TASK-0009 Codex executor mode and original unmodified publish/finalize gates. After exact-head review, publish a draft PR, require current CI, merge the exact reviewed head, and verify merged main CI/tests/package/native startup. Only then install this feature into the existing daily runnable copy. For each affected existing source/resource/build file, require its bytes to match the reviewed base before backing it up and replacing it. New paths must be absent. Preserve every other Java source (especially locally customized ChatService), all private settings, TTS/service files and launcher routing; do not copy or inspect secrets/model weights or restart a voice service. Keep a hash-indexed rollback manifest and verify both offline startup and the existing daily entry point. Stop only an exactly identified owned app process when a necessary app-only restart is possible.

Prewarm the immutable model and fixed camera on a background worker in both real startup and the standalone evaluation, before Swing constructs the panel. Cache the immutable action map so multiple renderers never iterate the runtime shared Array concurrently. Native smoke must still inspect the actual rendered icon; do not weaken its marker checks.
non_goals: No new artwork, editable Spine project reconstruction, model re-rigging, new fees, licence purchases, commercial release or unrelated deployment.
No ChatService changes, AI/TTS model changes, prompt/schema changes, private configuration reads, real audio samples, credentials, schedules or model weights in the worker, Git or CI.
No claims of phoneme-level lip sync, newly authored Talk/Thinking/Happy assets or confirmed licence ownership. User preview feedback does not pre-approve the subsequent merged delivery.
No further dispatcher/workflow, CI, authorization or check changes; use the independently merged TASK-0009 executor mode. Avoid unrelated styles or Maven wrapper edits.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: The pinned 3.8 model and atlas load offline with verified provenance; all six source actions render as nonempty transparent character images with correct region/mesh/atlas/PMA handling and stable unclipped framing.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Real-asset headless loading and renderer tests, host inspection of all-action previews on light/dark backgrounds, source hashes and sampled pose bounds.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: The desktop assistant visibly uses the Spine renderer, retains transparent window size/drag/double-click behaviour, and supports explicit frame fallback and automatic recoverable asset-load fallback without leaked timers/executors.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Player/panel resource-failure and close tests, actual native window smoke and host default/fallback render observations.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: A state layer enforces interaction priority and restores the currently valid talking/thinking/idle state after one-shots; speech start/finish and repeated taps do not get overwritten by stale completions.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Deterministic scheduling tests covering speech starting/ending during tap, overlapping or replaced actions, stale callbacks and stop/dispose.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Speech lifecycle, chat thinking and existing positive emotion visibly drive documented source-action/procedural variants; completion/error/disposal and concurrent requests restore a valid state without changing model protocols or speech generation.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Offline activity/listener and scheduling tests, talk/thinking preview differences, inspected UI wiring and regression tests; no real AI or TTS calls.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Provide repeatable launch/preview/fallback and rollback instructions, accurate provenance/licence requirements, and pass workflow/Java checks plus exact reviewed-head CI/merge and merged build/native smoke. Safely activate the feature in the existing daily runnable copy while preserving local chat customizations, private settings and voice services.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Full frozen checks and scoped technical review; actual PR/head CI and main push CI; clean merged delivery tests/package/native window; baseline/backup/installed-source hashes and unchanged protected-source inventory; offline native verification of the activated runtime and process-identity-bound daily app launch evidence. Licensing remains unconfirmed and is not inferred from technical PASS or user solution selection.

risks: Spine licence ownership is unconfirmed. Official licence obligations and the artwork noncommercial notice remain applicable. User solution selection and engineering adoption do not establish a licence or authorize fees/commercial use.
Software mesh rendering can expose rotated/cropped UV, PMA halo, seam, camera-bound and performance issues. Actual visual inspection is required in addition to nonblank-image tests.
The source only has six exported actions; procedural speech/emotion variants are approximations and must be described accurately. No source .spine project is available.
The existing live ChatService differs from reviewed main; preserve that local behaviour and never blanket-copy the clean checkout into the live application.
rollback: Keep hash-verified backups of every replaced daily-runtime file and a manifest of newly installed paths; restore only those files if activation fails. Preserve all other source/private settings and voice services. The documented -Dclosure.animation=frames switch immediately selects the legacy renderer. Revert the scoped feature through a normal reviewed change; never reset the dirty original checkout.
